claims: Monitor liver enzymes (ALT, AST) and coagulation parameters (PT/INR, PTT) serially given markedly elevated transaminases and rising INR/PTT.

Obtain blood cultures if infection suspected given fever and leukocytosis.
Continue heparin infusion with monitoring of PTT and platelet count.

Provide pulmonary hygiene with incentive spirometry and cough/deep breathing exercises given tachypnea and oxygen requirement.
Manage pain with IV morphine as ordered, reassessing pain level.
Maintain skin care and repositioning for Braden score indicating risk.
Continue telemetry and ST segment monitoring for arrhythmia detection.
